district_name: Central Vermont Career Center School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: the Central Vermont Career Center School District, a standalone regional technical (CTE) district under 16 V.S.A. ch. 37, subchapter 5A, created by the voters of its 18 member towns on March 1, 2022 (Secretary of Education Declaration under section 1575, April 4, 2022).
Central Vermont Career Center School District (official site).

board.org_name: Central Vermont Career Center School District Board

sources.note: CVCCSD About page (official, fetched 2026-10-22) + the voter-approved Formation Plan (Art. III): 10 voting seats = 4 at-large ELECTED (one resident of each of the four largest member districts -- Barre Unified, Harwood Unified, Washington Central, Montpelier Roxbury -- elected by ALL district voters on a commingled Australian ballot, 3-year terms) + 6 appointed by and from the member district boards (out of scope). Isabelle: re-elected March 4, 2025 as the ballot's sole candidate (roster + March 17, 2025 organizational minutes concur; end 2028 per the Plan's Appendix D cycle). Castle: elected 2023, resigned early 2025, board-appointed back March 17, 2025 for the remainder, then the SOLE printed candidate on the official March 3, 2026 ballot for a fresh 3-year term and seated as Vice Chair March 24, 2026 -- minted ELECTED end 2029 under the sole-candidate exception, disclosed. The Washington Central and Harwood at-large posts are built with NO memberships: their 2025 elections produced no winner and the board appointed Todd Comen and Wayne Goulet on April 14, 2025 (district minutes) to serve the remainders (to 2027 / 2028) -- appointed holders are out of scope this pass. Certified commingled returns for 2025/2026 were not located (flag).

directors.name: J. Guy Isabelle
directors.note: Re-elected March 4, 2025 (sole candidate on the ballot; roster and organizational minutes concur). Same person as the Barre justice of the peace record.

directors.name: Lyman Castle
directors.note: Vice Chair. Minted ELECTED under the sole-candidate exception -- see the board sources for his appointment-and-election chain.
